name: io.github.Neko-Yukari/aria2-mcp
title: aria2-mcp
description: Zero-config local aria2 download manager MCP server for AI agents with fail-closed OS proxy safety, resumable sessions, and non-destructive filenames.

environmentVariables.name: ARIA2_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Optional explicit path to the aria2c binary (auto-detected from PATH and common install locations by default).

environmentVariables.name: ARIA2_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional directory for local daemon rpc.json and downloads.session.

environmentVariables.name: ARIA2_DEFAULT_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional default proxy mode: system (default), direct, or explicit http://host:port.

environmentVariables.name: ARIA2_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional existing/remote aria2 JSON-RPC endpoint URL; skips spawning a local daemon when set.

environmentVariables.name: ARIA2_RPC_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional RPC secret token when using ARIA2_RPC_URL.
